remarks: Well maintained townhouse in the sought after River's Edge Complex. This property features over 1625 square feet of living space, 2 bed, 1.5 baths, a kitchen with beautiful countertops, dining area, living room and a primary suite with high ceilings and plenty of closet space, and fully finished 3rd floor with vaulted ceilings that offers plenty of options and flexibility. The lower level includes a 1 car garage and oversized laundry area with more closet space and the HOA offers a heated in ground pool, fitness center, and clubhouse. The heating system is new and can be controlled with your phone. Great proximity to restaurants, shopping, the train and to the Merritt Parkway. A true turn key property

facts.laundryLoc: Laundry Room is on the lower level
